interventions.detail: apt install python3-dev so scikit-learn-extra 0.3.0 can build from source (no py3.12 wheel)
Install CPU build of torch==2.7.1 from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu before installing protenix
export LAYERNORM_TYPE=torch to skip JIT compile of CUDA fused layernorm (fails: CUDA_HOME not set)
Set PROTENIX_ROOT_DIR and pre-download checkpoint/CCD via warm-up prediction in setup.sh
